releases.notes:
Release v0.3.7.

**Dwarven Mines**
- Commission Bot: King, claim, mining (titanium hunt), Glacite Walkers and Goblin Slayer with Combat, events skipped, starts anywhere using the tab commissions, reboot recovery (hub -> /warp forge), pauses while the AH flipper works
- Route map built from interaction recordings (stations, etherwarp points, mining centres); travel goes map point by map point inside the loaded world
- Mining helpers, commissions/overview panels, alerts

**Path engine**
- Baritone plans the whole way once; AOTV teleports, etherwarps and the player's etherwarp points are moves of the A* search itself (`MovementWarp`)
- Path tightened into a line, corners rounded into arcs
- Followed like a player: W held, camera steers, A/D only when pushed against a wall, never S; steers back instead of replanning
- Warps fire standing still; after landing it continues from the nearest path point; no auto warps while Combat follows a mob closely; a new Combat target means a new path at once
- Planned line drawn in the air, coloured by walk / jump / teleport / etherwarp

**Fail-safe and logger**
- Universal fail-safe (name in chat, item swap, block box, teleport and rotation checks) with test buttons
- Interaction logger (path, GUIs, clicks)

Built locally (`gradlew build -x updaterTest`); `updaterTest` only fails on Windows without symlink rights.

releases.notes:
## New: SkyBlock menu

Right Shift → click **SKYBLOCK** (left or right click) to open the new SkyBlock menu. Everything SkyBlock now lives in one place:

- **Sidebar:** Modules with the sections General, Skills, Trading, Mining, Dungeons and Misc (click to jump), Routes, Command Binds, an auto-generated **Documentation** page and **Customize** (HUD editor).
- **Module cards** with icon, description and an on/off switch. The gear opens the settings page.
- **Settings pages:** grouped, every setting with a short description of what it does. A search bar filters modules and settings.
- **Combat targets:** pick from a list of ~150 SkyBlock mobs (search by name or area), each with its **mob head**. Any other name can still be typed.
- **Bazaar item mode / blocked items:** pick from all Bazaar products or type part of a name.
- Investments, Bazaar Flips and Fire Sale moved in here (Trading). The Pathfinder settings are under **Misc → Pathfinder**. The INVESTMENT and PATHFINDER tabs are gone from the Controller Center.
- **General → Panel Style:** glass, edges and footer of every bot panel in one place.
- Investment, Bazaar Flips, Fire Sale and Customize return to the SkyBlock menu when closed.

## Sharper text everywhere

The UI font is now rendered pixel-exact for your GUI scale, so letters no longer look thicker/thinner or lighter/darker. Text is no longer cut in half at the edge of scrolling lists.

## Combat panel

New on-screen panel while Combat runs: state (searching, walking, fighting), current target and distance, the next targets, targets done, per hour and run time. Toggle and rows in the Combat module, move it with Customize.

## Item value tooltip

Now shows **Estimated Item Value** in a cleaner colour. The breakdown (market value used, median, lowest BIN, source ...) only appears with **Details** on (SkyBlock menu → Item Value) and is in English.

## Bazaar Flipper

- Sell offers are only merged as far as the items fit into your inventory (it learns which items don't stack, like Summoning Eyes). The rest stay as they are.
- New sell offers use **Same as Best Offer** when the best offer is already yours instead of undercutting yourself.
- Items claimed while cancelling a buy order become one sell offer; with a full inventory the claimed items are listed first.
- Hypixel's "Placing orders is on cooldown" is recognized: the flipper waits a minute instead of stopping.

## Other

- Lowballing and the Bazaar Flipper can no longer run at the same time (chat tells you to stop the other one first).
- Toggle keys in other menus only turn bots **off**, never on.
- KillAura moved back to **AUTOMATION**.
- The Controller Center scales with the window (F11) and remembers where you dragged its tabs and which ones were open.

mods.description: A Minecraft client with voice chat, Spotify, and a customizable liquid glass interface, plus Hypixel SkyBlock auction, bazaar and lowballing tools.

releases.notes:
## Bazaar item mode: finally fixed

Item mode makes the Bazaar Flipper trade **only the items you choose** instead of the analyzer's picks.

**How to use it**
1. Right Shift → **SKYBLOCK** → open the settings of **Bazaar Flipper**.
2. Turn on **Item mode**.
3. Type an item into **Flip item (Enter)** and press Enter. A part of the name is enough (`recomb` → *Recombobulator 3000*); the exact Bazaar product name is added and confirmed in chat. Click an entry in the list to remove it.
4. Start the Bazaar Flipper. It buys at best bid + 0.1 and sells at best offer − 0.1, only for the listed items, at the normal scan times.

When the flipper starts, chat now tells you whether item mode is **ON** (with the items it will flip) or **OFF** (analyzer picks), so you always know what it is about to do. With item mode on but an empty list, the flipper falls back to the analyzer.

## New: Bazaar investments in the Investment GUI

Right Shift → **INVESTMENT** → **Bazaar Flips GUI** (or the **Bazaar Flips** button in the AH Investment screen) opens a Bazaar version of the investment screen:

- The best flips right now, sorted by **coins per hour** (the **Sort** button switches to margin, profit per flip or score)
- Per item: buy order → sell offer, margin, volume per hour, fill chance, quantity, stake, profit per flip and coins/h, plus a coins/h bar
- Items on your item-mode list are marked with ★, and the header shows whether item mode is on
- Uses the flipper's own analysis, so the list is exactly what the bot would buy
- Filters under **Bazaar Flips Settings** in the same tab: min/max margin, weekly volume, min unit price, min order, max per item, min coins/h, price swing, price history, rows and refresh interval. These are the Bazaar Flipper's real filters: changing them changes the bot too.

## Pathfinder: fixed, now in the Combat module

The Pathfinder runs through the **Combat** module, which now lives in the **SKYBLOCK** tab (Combat + KillAura). Tuning stays in the **PATHFINDER** tab.

- **No more rubber-banding when falling or jumping.** The bot pressed sneak in mid-air, which the server answered with setbacks. Recorded runs went from 74 setbacks in 135 s to 1–2.
- **Stairs and slabs** are walked up instead of jumped. With Jump Boost every jump is priced by its real air time, so the bot prefers stairs and walking over hopping on every block.
- **Calm movement %** (Pathfinder tab, default 70): the camera looks further ahead on the path, turns slower and softer and skips tiny corrections. No more left-right twitching. Lower it for snappier movement.
- **Targets:** the next target is chosen right after a kill (no more standing still), switching is quicker, and the bot always picks the **next two targets ahead**.
- **One-hit mode** (Combat options): one click per target, then straight on to the next, already picked target without waiting for damage or death.
- **New overlay:** dashed path line on the floor, a target box that follows the mob smoothly and a yellow outline on the next targets. Toggle: **Show path + target** in the Pathfinder tab.

releases.notes:
Keeps the Bazaar flipper, AH flipper, bid macro, and lowballer running when you switch windows or press Escape.

- Escape releases the mouse without opening a pause menu that blocks active bots.
- Minimized and idle windows maintain at least 20 FPS while a bot is active, keeping client-thread GUI actions responsive.
- Normal pause and idle FPS behavior returns when the bots stop. A manually paused Bazaar flipper stays paused.
- Saved Minecraft pause and FPS settings remain unchanged.

Stop active bots with their toggle keys or **All off** to open the normal pause menu.

Requires Minecraft **26.2**, Fabric Loader **0.19.5+**, Fabric API, and Java **25+**.

Validation: full Gradle build and checks passed, plus the isolated Minecraft regression test for each bot's Escape/focus-loss paths, mouse release, AFK FPS floor, existing menus, manual pause, and stop/disconnect behavior.
